_readme: Consulting page. Packages and prices are copied from the current drlentau.com/consulting page. CONFIRM WITH LEN before launch.

seo.title: Consulting
seo.description: Consulting with Dr. Len Tau: a clear plan for your online reputation, reviews and marketing, and a team that runs it.

opener.title: You do great dentistry. | Your online presence | should prove it.
paragraphs: Dr. Wollock went from 10 cases a year to 30 a month. The dentistry did not change. Patients found the practice, trusted it, and chose it.
That is the work. We audit everything a new patient sees before they call. Then we build a plan your team runs every day without you.

signs.title: Five signs | you need help.
questions: New patient numbers are flat or falling
A competitor with weaker clinical skills outranks you on Google
You get fewer than 10 new reviews a month
Your hours or phone number are wrong on at least one directory
Nobody on your team owns the review ask

intro.title: Get clear on where you are | and where you need to go.
paragraphs: That is what consulting with me is for. We look at your whole online presence, then build a plan to create a steady flow of new patients.
Then we get your team on the same page, so the system runs every day without depending on you.

pricing.footnote: I recommend vendors I trust. Some pay me a referral fee or offer my clients a discount. I serve as General Manager of Birdeye's dental division. I tell you about every relationship before you buy.
